transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hello, doctor. Well, what brings me in is... I've been having some trouble with my eating habits lately. It usually happens when I start picking at the leftovers late at night. It's frustrating because it feels like the sensible part of me is right there saying, "That’s enough, Alejandro," but my hand just keeps going back for more anyway. I just can't seem to stop myself once I start.
Do you find yourself having episodes where you eat a lot of food in a short amount of time, even when you’re not hungry, and feel like you can’t stop once you start?

Yes, that's exactly what happens. Some nights after supper, when I’m supposed to be putting away the leftover tamales or the mole, I’ll just... I'll end up eating several servings right then and there. And then I might take some pan dulce out to the garage and eat that, too. It's a lot of food all at once. I mean, it's way more than I’d ever put on a plate if my family was actually there watching me.
When you're eating like this, do you feel like you can't control how much you eat or stop yourself once you start?

Yes, that is exactly it. Like I mentioned when we first started talking, I just don't have any control over it at all. The sensible part of my brain is right there telling me that is enough, Alejandro, you need to stop... but my hand just keeps going back for another bite anyway. It is like I just can't physically make myself walk away from the food once I get going.
Do these episodes make you feel upset, guilty, or ashamed afterward, or have they started to affect your daily life in any way, like your relationships or how you feel about yourself?

Yes, I do feel guilty and ashamed afterward. It's not a good feeling. As for my daily life, I'm still keeping up with my errands, my appointments, and helping my wife around the house. I haven't stopped doing what I need to do. But... the mornings after I eat like that, I just feel sluggish. And I definitely feel less proud of how I'm handling myself. It bothers me.
After these episodes of eating large amounts of food when you feel like you can't stop, do you ever try to compensate by making yourself vomit, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising excessively?

No, I don't do anything like that. I don't make myself throw up or take anything to clear it out. I don't skip meals the next day either, and I definitely don't exercise like crazy. I just... I just deal with feeling full and bad about it.
How often do these episodes happen? Do you have them at least once a week?

Well, looking back on it... yeah, I'd say these late-night leftover episodes happen at least once most weeks. Often it's two nights a week, actually. It's been going on like that pretty consistently ever since my cousin moved in with us.
